summary.text: Glorious son of Peisenor (`peisenor-trojan`), comrade of Polydamas son of Panthous, whom peerless Teucer smote as he held the reins and drove his horses where the battalions were driven in rout — distinct from Cleitus the Melampodid snatched by Dawn.

story.text: Teucer son of Telamon, bearing his bent-back bow, smote Cleitus the glorious son of Peisenor — comrade of lordly Polydamas — even as he was busied with his horses, driving them where the most battalions were being driven in rout.
